title: Wanderers
description: Monarch butterflies (Danaus plexippus) cluster on the trunk of an oyamel fir (Abies religiosa) in the Sierra Chincua Sanctuary, part of Mexico’s Monarch Butterfly Biosphere Reserve in Michoacán. The reserve protects the high-altitude forests and precise mountain microclimate that provide essential winter habitats for up to 70 percent of the world’s eastern monarch population.
translated_description: 黑脉金斑蝶（Danaus plexippus）聚集在一棵神圣冷杉（Abies religiosa）的树干上，地点位于钦库阿山脉保护区，该保护区是墨西哥米却肯州帝王蝶生物圈保护区的一部分。该保护区保护着高海拔森林和精确的山地微气候，为全球东部帝王蝶种群中多达70%的个体提供至关重要的越冬栖息地。
